name: Vishnuteja Ambati
tagline: Computer Engineering at Iowa State · AI systems, research & real-time engineering

intro.headline: Engineer. Researcher. Professional problem‑hunter.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Vishnu. I study Computer Engineering at Iowa State University, where I'll also pursue a minor in AI, after two years of Computer Science at BITS Pilani, one of India's most selective engineering schools.
I build AI systems that work outside the notebook: LLM pipelines and knowledge graphs, real-time computer vision, adversarial ML, INT8 models on FPGAs, and fast distributed backends.
I like hard problems, honest numbers, and software that survives contact with reality.
intro.currently: Founding Engineer at Hivemind, building Iris.
